title: My sister's wedding
instructions: Tom kız kardeşinin düğününü anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; yer, saat ve kişileri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last Saturday was my sister's wedding.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It was in a small church in our village at eleven o'clock.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My sister wore a long white dress, and her husband, Mark, wore a grey suit.

script.speaker: s
script.text: After the church, we had lunch in a big garden. There were one hundred people!

script.speaker: s
script.text: The food was very good. I ate a lot of cake.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the evening, there was music and everyone danced.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My grandmother danced with me. She is eighty years old, but she dances very well!

script.speaker: s
script.text: We went home at midnight. I was very tired but happy.

options: in a big church in the city
in a small church in their village
questions.evidence: It was in a small church in our village

questions.prompt: How many people were at the lunch?

questions.feedback: Seksen yaşındaki büyükannesi onunla dans etti.
